project_type: Node.js + TypeScript backend (Express API + MCP server), vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend, Firecracker microVM execution environment
build_system: npm with TypeScript compiler (tsc -b), no bundler currently
test_framework: Vitest with supertest for API testing. 22 test files in src/ subdirectories (*.test.ts)
test_command: npm test (vitest run), npm run test:coverage for coverage, sudo npm run test:e2e for Firecracker e2e
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to compile TypeScript, then npm test to run all unit tests. E2E tests require Linux with KVM and sudo. No linting/formatting checks in scripts currently (.eslintrc.json and .prettierrc.json exist but no npm run lint/format scripts in package.json).
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory from TypeScript compilation (gitignored). Templates build creates snapshots in /var/lib/agent-sandbox/artifacts/ (not in repo). No checked-in generated files.
environment_constraints: Project is designed for Linux with KVM and Firecracker. Running on Windows development machine currently, so actual VM functionality cannot be tested locally. Focus on structure, build, and tests that don't require actual Firecracker execution.
contribution_requirements: Per CONTRIBUTING.md: Use TypeScript for all source code with explicit types, follow Vitest testing (aim for >80% coverage), use kebab-case for files, camelCase for functions, PascalCase for classes, commit messages follow conventional commits format (type(scope): subject)
key_patterns: Server entrypoint is src/server.ts, Express app config in src/app.ts, all test files colocated with source (e.g., src/auth/middleware.ts + src/auth/middleware.test.ts), SDK is standalone in sdk/typescript/ with own package.json, templates/ contains Dockerfiles for VM environments, minimal-rootfs/ contains guest VM runtime
directory_structure: Root: package.json, tsconfig.json, config files | src/: TypeScript source (auth/, bench/, mcp/, routes/, session/, vm/ subdirs + top-level files) with colocated *.test.ts files | sdk/: typescript/ subdirectory with standalone SDK package | templates/: Dockerfiles for node, python, go, base environments + build.sh | minimal-rootfs/: Guest VM runtime (start.sh, runtime/runtime.js) | .github/: CI workflows
